ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is essential to investigate and address the underlying issues to ensure a smooth user experience. Recommendations include checking for large media files, excessive scripts, or server-side bottlenecks.
insights: The passed tests for the homepage, pricing page, and blog page indicate good performance, with load times well below the recommended 3-second threshold.
The "How It Works" page's failure suggests potential optimization opportunities. Investigating and addressing these issues will help improve user experience and prevent potential bounce rates.
Implementing general optimization practices, such as image optimization, minification, and caching, will further enhance the web performance of all pages.
